parameters.query:
WITH periodo AS (
  SELECT date_trunc('month', now()) - interval '1 month' AS inicio,
         date_trunc('month', now()) AS fin
)
SELECT
  (SELECT count(*) FROM conversations c, periodo
     WHERE c.iniciada_en >= periodo.inicio AND c.iniciada_en < periodo.fin) AS total_conversaciones,
  (SELECT count(*) FROM conversations c, periodo
     WHERE c.iniciada_en >= periodo.inicio AND c.iniciada_en < periodo.fin
       AND c.canal_origen = 'whatsapp') AS conversaciones_whatsapp,
  (SELECT count(*) FROM conversations c, periodo
     WHERE c.iniciada_en >= periodo.inicio AND c.iniciada_en < periodo.fin
       AND c.canal_origen = 'voice') AS conversaciones_voz,
  (SELECT count(*) FROM conversations c, periodo
     WHERE c.iniciada_en >= periodo.inicio AND c.iniciada_en < periodo.fin
       AND c.estado = 'escalada') AS conversaciones_escaladas,
  (SELECT json_object_agg(motivo, cnt) FROM (
     SELECT coalesce(escalada_motivo, 'sin_motivo_registrado') AS motivo, count(*) AS cnt
     FROM conversations c, periodo
     WHERE c.iniciada_en >= periodo.inicio AND c.iniciada_en < periodo.fin AND c.estado = 'escalada'
     GROUP BY 1
   ) t) AS escalamientos_por_motivo,
  (SELECT json_object_agg(herramienta, cnt) FROM (
     SELECT tc.herramienta, count(*) AS cnt
     FROM tool_calls tc JOIN conversations c ON c.id = tc.conversation_id, periodo
     WHERE c.iniciada_en >= periodo.inicio AND c.iniciada_en < periodo.fin
     GROUP BY 1
   ) t) AS llamadas_por_herramienta,
  (SELECT count(*) FROM tool_calls tc JOIN conversations c ON c.id = tc.conversation_id, periodo
     WHERE c.iniciada_en >= periodo.inicio AND c.iniciada_en < periodo.fin
       AND tc.herramienta = 'crear_cita' AND tc.estado = 'ok') AS citas_creadas,
  (SELECT round(avg(m.latencia_ms)) FROM messages m JOIN conversations c ON c.id = m.conversation_id, periodo
     WHERE c.iniciada_en >= periodo.inicio AND c.iniciada_en < periodo.fin
       AND m.rol = 'assistant' AND m.latencia_ms IS NOT NULL) AS latencia_prom_ms,
  (SELECT count(*) FROM calls ca JOIN conversations c ON c.id = ca.conversation_id, periodo
     WHERE c.iniciada_en >= periodo.inicio AND c.iniciada_en < periodo.fin) AS llamadas_voz_totales,
  (SELECT round(avg(ca.voice_duration_s)) FROM calls ca JOIN conversations c ON c.id = ca.conversation_id, periodo
     WHERE c.iniciada_en >= periodo.inicio AND c.iniciada_en < periodo.fin
       AND ca.voice_duration_s IS NOT NULL) AS duracion_prom_llamada_s;
-- LIMITACION DELIBERADA (ver README): esta consulta agrega TODAS las
-- clinicas, sin filtrar por clinic_id. Coherente con que el resto del
-- sistema (WHATSAPP_PHONE_ID, CLINIC_ID) hoy solo soporta una clinica en
-- produccion (ver decisiones.md, vacio 5). Multi-clinica exigiria repetir
-- este bloque por clinic_id, que no se implemento aqui para no fingir una
-- capacidad multi-tenant que el resto del nucleo tampoco tiene todavia.
